title: [BUG] /install-github-app not progressing past providing the organization/repository when running in termux
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [x] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [ ] Other: <!-- specify -->
- Claude CLI version: 1.0.53 (Claude Code)
- Operating System: Android 15, running in termux
- Terminal:  termux/bash

## Bug Description
When asked to provide the organization/repository and pressing enter nothing happens.
I tried both organization/repository and https://github.com/organization/repository without success.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Start Claude
2. Type /install-github-app
3. Follow the instructions until asked for organization/repository 
4. Press enter, notice nothing is happening 

## Expected Behavior
The installation process continues properly and sets up the secret in the repository.

## Actual Behavior
The CLI is stuck and needs to be killed as CTRL+C only clears the input field.

## Additional Context
n/a
author: tomzx
